presets.name: S-curve
presets.description: Standard contrast. Shadows down, highlights up, midtone slope steepened.

presets.name: Faded
presets.description: Lifted blacks and pulled whites. The print-film-emulation look.

presets.name: Crush
presets.description: Deep blacks, held highlights. Harder than an S-curve at the bottom.

presets.name: Matte
presets.description: Lifted shadows with a soft shoulder. Flatter than faded, no white pull.

presets.name: Cool shadows
presets.description: Blue lifted in the shadows, red pulled. Split-tone with per-channel curves.

presets.name: Warm highlights
presets.description: Red raised and blue lowered above the midpoint. Sunlight on skin.
